investigation_notes.Description: An Office 365 login occurred from Hong Kong to arne.tamm@client.ee on endpoint T12345785, and the login was successful with MFA enabled. IP reputation shows the source as a non-anonymized fixed-line ISP in Hong Kong with no VPN or proxy detected. Historical activity includes logins from Tallinn and Macao around the same period, with a prior Macao alert closed as a client-confirmed travel case. Given MFA usage and plausible travel context, the activity is considered Low Priority.
